body: LeBron James has officially arrived in Philadelphia The King showed up to media day for his first season with the Philadelphia 76ers, marking the beginning of a brand-new chapter in his legendary career. After putting pen to paper on a reported two-year deal, LeBron is now preparing to suit up in Philly and take on a new challenge alongside a talented Sixers roster.

source_caption_text:
LeBron James has officially arrived in Philadelphia🏀👑

The King showed up to media day for his first season with the Philadelphia 76ers, marking the beginning of a brand-new chapter in his legendary career. After putting pen to paper on a reported two-year deal, LeBron is now preparing to suit up in Philly and take on a new challenge alongside a talented Sixers roster.

From Cleveland to Miami, Los Angeles and now Philadelphia, LeBron continues to add new chapters to one of the most remarkable careers basketball has ever seen. At this stage, every new season carries another level of anticipation — and his arrival in Philadelphia has the basketball world watching closely.
